name: Faith
level 2 (4 tags): every hit on undead or spirits heals the hero for 3% of the damage
level 3 (6 tags): the first knockout of the run is revived at 25% HP

name: Wild
level 2 (4 tags): after each won fight against beasts the party heals 5% and gains +1 fang or horn
level 3 (6 tags): once per run a calmed beast fights for the party

name: Watch
level 2 (4 tags): the scout finds a way round: skip one fight per run (the weakest)
level 3 (6 tags): +crit against elites; the party always acts first

name: Cunning
level 1 (2 tags): in round 1, a trap hits a random enemy for 10% of its HP
level 2 (4 tags): runs take 15% less time; hidden cache steps pay their gold
level 3 (6 tags): an extra loot roll from every hidden cache step, Hidden cache and Sealed vault

name: Venom
level 1 (2 tags): hits have a 10% chance to poison, even without the Venomous affix
level 2 (4 tags): poison stacks up to 3 times on an enemy (each Venomous hit adds a stack, 30% of the hit over 3 rounds; without Venom 2 a new hit refreshes the one poison)
level 3 (6 tags): poisoned enemies take +20% damage from everyone

name: Warding
level 2 (4 tags): the first elemental hit of each fight is absorbed
level 3 (6 tags): 20% of elemental damage taken is reflected

name: Breaker
level 2 (4 tags): crits stagger the target (it loses its next turn)
level 3 (6 tags): the first hit of each fight shreds 30% of the target's armour

name: Bulwark
level 2 (4 tags): the front hero guards the weakest ally (takes 35% of each hit aimed at them)
level 3 (6 tags): the first hit of each fight on the party deals −35% damage

name: Bloodrage
level 3 (6 tags): below 25% HP an extra attack each round

name: Shadow
level 2 (4 tags): +6 evasion; a dodged attack gives a free counter (30% of a hit)
level 3 (6 tags): each fight a 45% chance the weakest enemy is struck down before it acts

name: Volley
level 3 (6 tags): a volley hits every enemy once per fight

name: Spellweave
level 2 (4 tags): an Infused (elemental) hit jumps to a second enemy for 30% in the same element

name: Pack
level 3 (6 tags): an extra summon each fight even without a summoner (35% of the hero's hit)

name: Rally
level 3 (6 tags): every special gets one extra use per run

name: Plunder
level 3 (6 tags): loot rolls one rarity step higher
